title: The sync range leak gate refuses internal-root content that the tracked-file scan accepts, so a team clone cannot sync its own internal facts
goal: kbpublic.range_leaks reads the files of an internal root and of a pointer for secrets only, as tree_hits does, so a team clone's sync leak gate passes the internal-root facts the tracked-file scan passes; a secret in a file of an internal root or of a pointer is still refused by the sync leak gate, and so is any hit in a file outside them; kbpublic.SCAN_FORM is above 6, so no range verdict cached under the old rule is read

run:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
def sh(*a, cwd=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
env = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t")
guid = "-".join(["3f2b8c1e", "9d4a", "4e7b", "8a61", "5c0d2e9f7b13"])
def clone():
    t = tempfile.mkdtemp(); c = t + "/c"; os.mkdir(c)
    subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", c], input=subprocess.run(["git", "archive", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout, check=True)
    return t, c
def commit(c, m):
    sh("git", "add", "-A", cwd=c, env=env); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", m, "--no-verify", cwd=c, env=env)
t, c = clone()
sh("git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", cwd=c, env=env); commit(c, "base")
up = sh("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=c, env=env).stdout.strip()
os.makedirs(c + "/kb/team-a/mdm")
open(c + "/kb/team-a/_root.md", "w").write("---\nroot: team-a\nid_prefix: TA\nvisibility: internal\ndescription: team a\n---\n\n# team-a\n")
mail = "jan" + chr(64) + "realcorp.io"
open(c + "/kb/team-a/mdm/tenant.md", "w").write("# Tenant\n\nThe production tenant is %s, contact %s.\n" % (guid, mail)); commit(c, "team root")
code = "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbpublic as k; print(k.tree_hits('HEAD', ['kb/team-a/mdm/tenant.md'], '.')); print(k.range_leaks(sys.argv[1], '.'))"
r = sh(sys.executable, "-I", "-c", code, up, cwd=c, env=env)
shutil.rmtree(t, ignore_errors=True)
lines = r.stdout.strip().splitlines()
assert len(lines) == 2, ("unexpected output", r.stdout[-200:], r.stderr[-200:])
tree, rng = lines
assert tree != "[]" or rng == "[]", ("the range gate refuses internal-root content the tracked-file scan accepts", rng[:200])

notes: Review gap 2 of SP-kkov6bbz (reviewer marked PLAUSIBLE): kbpublic.py:584 tree_hits treats internal roots, pointers and kb/_querylog as secret-only (:599); leak_verdicts has no such rule; sync runs the step with kb.publishRemote unset too.
